scripts.directus:up: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env --env-file apps/directus/.env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.directus.yml up -d directus
scripts.directus:down: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env --env-file apps/directus/.env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.directus.yml down
scripts.directus:logs: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env --env-file apps/directus/.env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.local.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.directus.yml logs -f directus
scripts.reader:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.reader:workers:rag: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names enhancement,artifact,rag --prefix-colors green,yellow,cyan "pnpm reader:worker:enhancement" "pnpm reader:worker:artifact" "pnpm reader:worker:rag"
scripts.reader:dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,enhancement,artifact --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm reader:api" "pnpm reader:web" "pnpm reader:worker:enhancement" "pnpm reader:worker:artifact"
scripts.reader:dev:rag: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,enhancement,artifact,rag --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green,yellow,cyan "pnpm reader:api" "pnpm reader:web" "pnpm reader:worker:enhancement" "pnpm reader:worker:artifact" "pnpm reader:worker:rag"
